notes.title: DodgeKill is now in Early Access !
notes.content: [h2]The game is now available for purchase ![/h2][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3113950/DodgeKill/" style="button"]Store Page[/url][/p][h3]Can you survive until the end ?[/h3][p]Enjoy a dynamic game that won't let your rest! 7 levels await you in this first Early Access, and will put your nerves to the test! And if that's not enough for you, challenges await you after each level. Will you have the courage to increase the difficulty?[/p][p][/p][h3]A game accessible to all![/h3][p]Keyboard, controller or even touch screens, if you don't have a mouse, the game can be played with any other controller![/p][p]Accessibility settings are also available :[/p][list][*][p]Special palettes for color blind people[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement and vibration strength settings[/p][/*][*][p]Disable rhythm effects and background movements[/p][/*][/list][h3]Warning[/h3][p]Event will accessibility settings, [i]DodgeKill[/i] remains [b]not recommended for photosensitive or epileptic people![/b] For the most eye-friendly game experience, turn on the Monochromatic mode and turn off every effect! On the other hand, it will turn off any color on every levels for a common Black & White color palette, you will therefore not benefit from the colors originally planned.[/p]

tags.feature: - Special palettes for color blind people
- Camera movement and vibration strength settings
- Disable rhythm effects and background movements

notes.title: Participation in the Steam Next Fest !
notes.content: [h3]A demo [b]update[/b] is available for the occasion![/h3][p][/p][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]An improved combo counter[/p][/*][*][p]A new life gain animation[/p][/*][*][p]Several crashs and bugs fixed here and there[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Feel free to try the game and give us as much feedback as possible; we can't wait to see what you think![/p]
